C-ZAI-DIRECT-WEB-PROVIDERS.IntentSummary: Extend the strict vvoc web configuration with an explicit-region zai provider, implement one direct Z.AI and Zhipu Tool API adapter for normalized search and reader results, route the existing canonical web_search and web_fetch services through that adapter without changing their model-facing schemas, preserve direct media attachments and bounded credential-safe transport, document ordinary API billing, and synchronize the owning GRACE graph and verification projections.

T-001.Title: Extend strict vvoc web configuration with the explicit-region zai provider.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Update vvoc-config.ts module contracts, exported web config types, embedded schema, normalization, and rendering so search and fetch accept provider zai and preserve region international or china.
Use schema conditions so selecting provider zai requires a valid explicit region while existing provider documents remain valid without region.
Keep schemas/vvoc/v3.json exactly equivalent to the embedded web schema and preserve strict rejection of unknown providers, regions, and properties.
Extend config.ts resolved search and fetch unions with zai, region, ZAI_API_KEY, endpoint-safe credential metadata, and environment-over-config precedence without logging values.

Focused tests cover both regions, missing-region rejection, invalid-region rejection, normalization and render round trips, existing-provider compatibility, native credential freedom, and shared ZAI_API_KEY precedence.
Edited source and test MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and CHANGE_SUMMARY blocks remain accurate and paired.

T-002.Title: Implement the direct Z.AI and Zhipu Tool API adapter with deterministic provider coverage.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Add providers/zai.ts with one bounded direct-HTTP search path and one reader path selected exclusively by the resolved region.
International search targets api.z.ai with search-prime; China search targets open.bigmodel.cn with search_pro; both map canonical query, count, and freshness into documented request fields.
Search parsing validates the response envelope, normalizes link, content, and publish_date into the shared WebSearchResult shape, preserves order, and skips entries without a valid URL.
Reader requests target the selected region's /reader endpoint with url, timeout, and return_format and validate reader_result.content plus optional title, request ID, model, and creation metadata.
The fetch adapter probes supported direct media through the existing media loader first and invokes the reader endpoint only when the target is not a supported attachment.

Extend the shared provider error name union for zai and map HTTP authentication, rate limit, provider, malformed-response, timeout, abort, network, oversized, and unsupported outcomes without credential leakage.

zai.test.ts covers both regional endpoints and engines, request headers and bodies, search normalization, malformed envelopes, media bypass, textual reader output, metadata, errors, abort and timeout propagation, and secret-safe messages with injected fetch only.
The new adapter has complete GRACE module contract, map, change summary, and bounded semantic blocks.

T-003.Title: Route canonical web_search and web_fetch through zai while preserving tool contracts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: search-service.ts dispatches zai to the direct adapter after the existing web_search permission request and execution-time credential validation, without changing query, count, or freshness schema bounds.
fetch-service.ts dispatches zai after HTTP or HTTPS validation and the existing web_fetch permission request, without changing format or timeout schema bounds.
Structured results retain the canonical title and output contract and include safe provider zai, region, format, result count, credential source, and available request metadata.
Missing Z.AI credentials name ZAI_API_KEY and the applicable config field without a value; existing Exa, Brave, native, and Spider dispatch and metadata remain unchanged.
WebToolsPlugin logs selected provider, region, and credential source safely, preserves explicit user built-in permissions, and continues registering exactly web_search and web_fetch.

Service and plugin tests prove permission-before-network ordering, both regional routes, missing credentials, output normalization, attachment results, metadata, existing provider regression behavior, and credential-safe diagnostics.
Edited service, plugin, and test contracts, maps, summaries, and block anchors remain accurate.

T-004.Title: Run the integrated web-tools regression gate and resolve only in-scope failures.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All web-tools configuration, transport, conversion, media, provider, service, and plugin tests pass together with no live network dependency.
Type checking, lint, and formatting checks pass for the implementation, and fixes remain inside the approved observed write scope unless new evidence requires an explicit reroute.
No generated dist output, user OpenCode configuration, MCP configuration, credential file, or unrelated provider behavior is modified.

Verification.Command: bun test src/lib/vvoc-config.test.ts src/plugins/web-tools.test.ts src/plugins/web-tools/*.test.ts src/plugins/web-tools/providers/*.test.ts

T-005.Title: Document direct Z.AI provider behavior and synchronize GRACE ownership and verification.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: README documents provider zai for search and fetch, required international or china region, ZAI_API_KEY precedence, exact regional base endpoints, restart behavior, direct media handling, and ordinary API billing rather than Coding Plan MCP quota.
README explicitly states that WebToolsPlugin makes direct REST calls and neither requires nor manages the Z.AI remote MCP servers.
Add M-WEB-ZAI to the routed graph with accurate paths, purpose, dependencies, and V-M-WEB-ZAI ownership; update dependent module descriptions and dependencies where behavior changed.
Add V-M-WEB-ZAI to the verification projection and update existing config, plugin, search-service, and fetch-service entries with the new deterministic scenarios and commands.
Graph and verification indexes directly own every new semantic anchor, and current source LINKS fields match routed GRACE ownership.
Documentation commands, paths, endpoint names, provider names, and billing caveats are checked against current source and the approved specification.

T-006.Title: Complete package, schema, and repository verification without billed provider calls.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The focused test command from the specification passes with fresh output.
bun run check, bun run build, and bun run release:check pass with the canonical schema and package surface synchronized.
GRACE lint and status report no new errors attributable to C-ZAI-DIRECT-WEB-PROVIDERS; any pre-existing repository-wide integrity errors are recorded separately and not repaired outside scope.
git diff contains only approved implementation, documentation, schema, tests, and GRACE lifecycle files, with no secrets or generated dist files.
No real Z.AI or Zhipu request is required for completion; a live smoke test remains optional and requires separate explicit authorization because it may consume paid balance.
